content.title: Use Cmd/Ctrl + K to focus the global search field
content.test_md_blob:
# Use Cmd/Ctrl + K to focus the global search field

> Prove the documented keyboard shortcut moves focus to the global search field and exposes a visible focus indicator without requiring pointer interaction.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Store whether the global search field is focused as shortcut_focus_baseline before invoking the keyboard shortcut.

## Step 3

With browser focus outside the global search field, invoke Cmd + K on macOS or Ctrl + K on non-macOS to trigger the documented global-search shortcut.

## Step 4

Assert the global search field is now focused and a visible focus ring is shown around it.

## Step 5

Assert the focused global search field still measures 420px wide and 36px high.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-160, ac-161, ac-162, ac-163

Confirm state-transition check: focused (equals) — the stated promise: Pressing Cmd/Ctrl + K focuses the global search field.
